main_text.p: poenitentiam ultimorum temporum excitare. v. Ille, Gentiles Dei longanimitate & tolerantia, invitari, provocari ad sanio-rem mentem & resipiscentiam; Hic, fideles qualemcunque Dei moram ac dilatio-nem adventus, debere [σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθαι?]: in electorum bonum salutemq; interpreta-ri, dum iis omnibus resipiscentiæ spatium tempusque concedit. vi. Ille vocem [μετα-νοίας?] latius (vel ringente nupero quodâ, sed lævo, & mordaci, & cujus inanem factum alibi retundimus, Apologistâ) pro resipiscentiâ externâ & morali, per abruptum scelerum ac facinorum filum, qualis in Ethnicis, ex solo divinæ longanimitatis sensu, in statu destituto, exoriri potuit; Hic strictius, pro resipiscentiâ interna & salutari, in electis omnibus, Dominicum ante adventum, promovenda. Adeoque nemo non intelligit, diversissimam hactenus esse loci utriusque rationem, affinitatem longè maximam Petrum inter & Authorem Epistolæ ad Hebræos, ubi identitas & argumenti & scopi & personarum quas uterque compellat.

page.notes: The Greek words "σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθαι" and "μετα-νοίας" are read uncertainly from the scan and are marked [?]. The word "abruptum" is printed with a hyphen at the line end ("abru-ptum"); it is transcribed as "abruptum" without the hyphen. The scan is blurred and some letters are doubtful. The numeral "VIII" at the lower right is treated as a section number, not a catchword or signature.
